title: Terms & Conditions
body:
# Terms & Conditions

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

Welcome to HastaBazaar. These terms govern shopping, accounts and use of our marketplace. By placing an order or registering an account, you agree to the terms presented to you at that time.

## Our marketplace

HastaBazaar connects customers with independent sellers. Sellers are responsible for their products, listing information and fulfilment obligations. HastaBazaar manages the marketplace and supports order enquiries, complaints and resolutions. Our role as a marketplace does not remove our responsibilities to customers under law.

## Accounts and acceptable use

You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into an agreement to open an account or place an order. Purchases for someone under 18 must be made by a parent or guardian.

Provide accurate contact, delivery and payment information. Keep your account credentials confidential and tell us promptly about suspected unauthorised use. You are not responsible for losses caused by HastaBazaar's own security failures merely because they involve your account.

Fraud, impersonation, payment abuse, false orders, harassment, malicious software, unauthorised access and unlawful use of the marketplace are prohibited.

## Products and descriptions

Product listings must accurately describe the item, materials, size, quantity, price, origin and relevant care or safety information. Warranty and customisation terms must be disclosed before purchase.

Handmade products can have small variations in colour, texture or finish when these are consistent with their description. Such variations do not excuse defects, incorrect materials or a product that differs materially from what was ordered.

## Prices, payments and orders

Prices are stated in Nepalese rupees. Applicable product taxes, delivery charges, discounts and the total payable must be disclosed before you confirm an order. No additional amount can be charged without your agreement.

Use only the payment methods offered during checkout. An order acknowledgement confirms receipt of your request; an order acceptance confirms that it will be fulfilled. Payment alone does not permit a seller to substitute a different product or change the agreed price. You are entitled to a receipt or invoice for your payment.

An order that cannot be fulfilled because of unavailable stock, an uncorrectable listing error or a legal restriction will be cancelled and any payment refunded. We will explain the reason. We will not change an accepted order without your agreement.

## Delivery, returns and refunds

Our Shipping & Delivery Policy and Return, Exchange, Cancellation & Refund Policy form part of your purchase terms. No seller-specific condition can reduce the protections in those policies or your legal rights.

## Reviews and content

Reviews must reflect genuine experiences. Fake reviews, undisclosed paid endorsements, threats and publication of another person's private information are prohibited. A review will not be removed solely because it is negative.

You retain ownership of content you submit. You give HastaBazaar permission to display, format and reproduce that content as needed to operate and promote the relevant listing or marketplace service. You must have the necessary rights to anything you upload. Private messages and verification documents are not promotional content.

## Account restrictions

We may restrict an account or remove content to address fraud, safety risks, unlawful activity or a breach of these terms. We will explain the reason and provide a way to request review, unless disclosure is legally prohibited or would compromise an investigation. Restrictions do not cancel valid refund claims or other outstanding obligations.

## Complaints, legal rights and changes

For assistance or complaints, email support@hastabazaar.com with your order or account details. You remain free to approach the competent consumer authority or court in Nepal.

Nepalese law governs these terms. Nothing here excludes a responsibility or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded. Updated terms apply prospectively and do not reduce rights attached to an existing order. Material changes affecting an ongoing account will be communicated before taking effect.

title: Return, Exchange, Cancellation & Refund Policy
body:
# Return, Exchange, Cancellation & Refund Policy

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

This policy applies to purchases made through HastaBazaar. Contact support@hastabazaar.com with your order number and the assistance you need.

## Standard returns

You may request a return within 7 calendar days after delivery when an item is unused, unaltered and complete with its accessories and labels. Keep the original packaging where reasonably possible and provide your invoice, receipt or order confirmation.

For goods supplied with an original seal, the return window is 15 calendar days after delivery when the seal remains intact. These windows do not shorten any longer right available under law or an applicable warranty.

An in-time request remains valid when collection or our response takes place later. We will provide the return address and collection or dispatch instructions.

## Damaged, defective, incorrect or misdescribed items

Contact us promptly when an item arrives damaged, is defective, is incomplete, is not the item ordered or differs materially from its description. Tell us what happened and provide available photographs or other relevant evidence.

An unboxing video is not compulsory. Opening packaging to inspect an item does not, by itself, invalidate a claim about a defect or incorrect delivery. Missing packaging does not remove rights concerning an item that was defective or misdescribed.

A valid claim can be resolved by a refund, replacement or another remedy you agree to. You do not have to accept a replacement instead of a refund when you are entitled to your money back. Claims about hidden defects and warranty problems are not automatically rejected because the standard return window has ended.

## Items affected by use, damage or deterioration

A change-of-mind return does not cover an item you have used, altered or damaged after delivery, an item whose original seal you have broken, or a rapidly perishable item. An item that deteriorates because it was stored or handled contrary to reasonable instructions is not eligible on that basis.

These exclusions do not apply to a problem that existed when the item was supplied or to a remedy required by law.

## Custom-made products

Custom-made products are assessed against the specifications approved when ordering. A product that is defective, damaged, incorrect or different from those specifications remains eligible for an appropriate remedy. Customisation does not remove your legal rights.

## Cancellations

You may cancel before dispatch by contacting support. For a custom-made order, request cancellation before production begins. Once production has begun, cancellation depends on the agreed order terms and your legal rights; costs cannot be introduced after purchase.

After dispatch, the return process applies. Where cancellation is required because a seller cannot fulfil the order or fails to meet an agreed delivery commitment, a custom-made label does not prevent a refund.

## Return costs and exchanges

We arrange returns for damaged, defective, incorrect or misdescribed items without charging the customer. We do not charge restocking fees or deduct marketplace commission from customer refunds.

For a voluntary change-of-mind return, any lawful return-transport charge must have been disclosed before purchase. Where the law prohibits a return charge, none will apply.

Exchanges depend on availability and your agreement. We will confirm the replacement and any price difference before proceeding. An exchange is not a compulsory substitute for a refund.

## Refunds

A full eligible item refund includes the amount paid for that item and its associated product taxes. For an order that is not delivered, or is returned in full because it is defective, incorrect or misdescribed, the refund also includes the original delivery charge. For a partial return, we refund delivery charges attributable to the affected item.

Refunds are processed without undue delay and no later than 7 calendar days after an accepted cancellation or receipt of an eligible return. When no return is required, the period starts when the refund entitlement is confirmed. An earlier legal deadline takes priority, and internal approval procedures cannot extend it.

Refunds go to the original payment method where supported. For cash payments or a payment method that cannot receive a refund, we agree a bank transfer or another lawful monetary method with you. Store credit is provided only when you choose it.

Your bank or payment provider controls when a processed refund appears in your account. We will provide confirmation and help investigate a missing refund. Customer refunds are not postponed while HastaBazaar recovers money from a seller or delivery provider.

title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
body:
# Shipping & Delivery Policy

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

This policy explains delivery arrangements for orders placed through HastaBazaar.

## Delivery availability and charges

Delivery is available to the locations accepted for your order. The delivery charge and expected delivery date or period must be disclosed before you place the order. We do not promise delivery to an address that has not been accepted.

Orders containing products from different sellers may arrive separately. Separate delivery charges must be included in the total shown before purchase.

## Preparation and dispatch

Preparation time and transport time are different. A made-to-order product's preparation period must be stated in its listing or agreed order details. Sellers must meet the preparation and dispatch commitments accepted with the order.

Order and dispatch updates are sent through the contact details provided for the purchase. Tracking details are supplied where the delivery service provides them.

## Delivery information

Provide a complete address, a working phone number and any essential access instructions. Tell us promptly about a correction. Changes after dispatch depend on the parcel's location and the delivery service's ability to redirect it; any lawful additional charge requires your agreement.

A parcel must be handed to you or a person you have authorised to receive it. Leaving it unattended requires your authorisation. A tracking status alone does not resolve a genuine non-delivery complaint.

## Delays and unsuccessful delivery

We will notify you of a known material delay and explain the available options. A revised delivery date requires your agreement. Where delivery fails or you are legally entitled to cancel because of delay, we will arrange the appropriate refund.

When an attempt fails because the address is incorrect or the authorised recipient is unavailable, we will contact you about the next step. Any lawful redelivery cost must have been disclosed before purchase and confirmed before the additional service is arranged.

You will not be charged an additional delivery fee to correct an error caused by HastaBazaar, the seller or the delivery provider.

## Missing, damaged or incorrect parcels

Email support@hastabazaar.com with your order number and the issue. Keep available packaging and photographs to help us investigate. An unboxing video is not required.

We will coordinate the investigation and remedy rather than require you to resolve the problem with the carrier alone. Customer rights concerning loss, damage or incorrect delivery are not waived when a seller hands the parcel to a delivery provider.

Returns, replacements and refunds are handled under our Return, Exchange, Cancellation & Refund Policy.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
# Privacy Policy

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

Hasta Bazaar Private Limited is responsible for the handling of personal information described in this policy. This policy explains the handling of personal information in connection with HastaBazaar accounts, seller applications, purchases and support requests.

## Information covered

Account and order information includes the name, email address, phone number, delivery address, purchase details and correspondence you provide.

Seller information includes business and contact details, registration or tax documents needed for verification, product information and settlement details. Verification documents are not public listing content.

Transaction information includes payment status, references, refunds and settlement records. Technical information associated with website use can include an IP address, browser information and security or activity logs. We limit collection to information needed for the stated purpose.

## How information is used

We use personal information to provide requested services, manage accounts, assess seller applications, process orders, arrange delivery, handle payments and refunds, respond to enquiries, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations.

Information must not be reused for an unrelated purpose without an appropriate legal basis and any required consent. Marketing permission is separate from order and account communications. You can withdraw marketing permission by contacting support@hastabazaar.com.

## Sharing information

Sellers receive the information needed to fulfil their orders and address relevant after-sales issues. Delivery and payment providers receive information necessary for their services. Providers supporting hosting, communications, security and administration must handle information only for authorised purposes and with appropriate protection.

Information may also be disclosed when required by law or necessary to respond to a lawful request from a competent authority. We do not sell personal information.

Sellers must not use customer contact details for unsolicited marketing, unrelated sales or unauthorised sharing.

## Payments and sensitive information

Use the payment process offered at checkout. Do not send account passwords, payment PINs, one-time passwords or full card security details through email, messages or support attachments. We do not request these credentials for support or refunds.

We restrict access to verification and settlement information to people who need it for their duties. Collection of an identification document must have a specific verification or legal purpose.

## Retention and protection

Information is retained for the period needed to provide the service, maintain required transaction records, handle claims and meet legal retention duties. When no longer needed, it is deleted or anonymised, subject to lawful preservation requirements.

We use reasonable access controls and organisational and technical safeguards to protect information. We do not promise that any online service is completely risk-free.

Information processed through a service provider remains subject to the protections in this policy. Any transfer requiring notice, consent or another legal safeguard must satisfy that requirement before it takes place.

## Your choices and requests

Contact support@hastabazaar.com to request access, correction, account closure, deletion or withdrawal of consent. We may verify your identity before acting. We will explain when information must be retained or a request cannot lawfully be fulfilled.

Withdrawing optional consent does not affect an earlier lawful use. An account deletion request does not cancel a pending order, refund or legal recordkeeping obligation.

Public reviews and product content are visible to other users. Do not include private information that you do not wish to publish.

## Children and changes

Accounts and seller registrations are intended for adults. Contact us if you believe a child has provided personal information without appropriate authority so that we can review and address it.

Material changes to how personal information is handled will be communicated before they take effect. We will request fresh consent where required. Privacy questions and complaints can be sent to support@hastabazaar.com.

title: Cookie Policy
body:
# Cookie Policy

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

This policy covers cookies and similar browser storage used in connection with HastaBazaar.

## What cookies do

Cookies are small pieces of information stored by a browser. Similar technologies include local storage and session storage. They can support sign-in, shopping baskets, security and saved choices.

## Necessary storage

Storage that is strictly needed to provide a service you request supports functions such as account sessions, basket continuity, fraud prevention and remembering privacy choices. It must not be used as a way to introduce unrelated advertising tracking.

## Optional tracking

Optional analytics or advertising technologies require a separate choice and any consent required by law before activation. Simply visiting the website does not count as agreement to optional tracking. Refusing it does not remove access to essential shopping functions.

Where optional technologies are offered, their purpose, provider and duration must be explained when the choice is presented. A materially different tracking purpose requires a new choice.

## Managing storage and preferences

You can inspect, block or delete cookies and website storage through your browser settings. Blocking necessary storage can interrupt sign-in, basket or checkout functions. Deleting cookies does not delete order records held separately by HastaBazaar.

To withdraw optional consent or ask about browser storage associated with HastaBazaar, email support@hastabazaar.com. Withdrawal stops the relevant future consent-based use; it does not by itself reverse earlier lawful processing.

Payment and other third-party services may provide their own cookie information when you use their services. Our Privacy Policy explains the broader handling of personal information.

title: Prohibited & Restricted Products Policy
body:
# Prohibited & Restricted Products Policy

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

Products listed on HastaBazaar must be lawful, safe and accurately described. This policy applies to product listings, images, descriptions and seller communications.

## Prohibited products

HastaBazaar does not permit illegal, stolen, counterfeit or recalled goods; goods that unlawfully use another person's intellectual property; or products made or traded through unlawful exploitation.

Firearms, ammunition, explosives, weapons marketed for unlawful harm, illegal drugs, tobacco and vaping products, and alcoholic beverages are not permitted on the marketplace.

Also prohibited are unsafe or expired products, hazardous substances unsuitable for ordinary consumer delivery, protected wildlife or illegally traded animal products, unlawfully traded cultural property, stolen personal data and products intended to facilitate fraud or unauthorised access.

Sexual material involving children, non-consensual intimate material and products promoting unlawful violence or abuse are prohibited.

## Restricted categories

Products subject to licensing, safety, labelling or special handling requirements need HastaBazaar's written approval before listing. These include food, cosmetics, supplements, medicines, medical devices, electrical goods and children's safety products.

Approval requires the relevant legal authorisations and product evidence. A submitted listing or an open seller account does not, by itself, approve a restricted category. Marketplace approval does not replace a licence required by law.

## Accurate descriptions and authenticity

Sellers must have the right to sell each product and must provide accurate information about its maker, origin, materials, condition and safety. Claims such as handmade, locally made, organic, certified or therapeutic must be supported by appropriate evidence.

Products must not be advertised with false reviews, misleading images, concealed defects or unsupported guarantees. An approval or verification process is not a guarantee that every product is suitable for every use.

## Reports and enforcement

Report a product concern to support@hastabazaar.com with the listing details, an explanation and available evidence. For an intellectual-property complaint, identify the protected work or right and explain your authority to raise the complaint.

We may pause or remove a listing, request documents, cancel affected orders or restrict a seller account while addressing a concern. Confirmed violations can lead to permanent removal, customer remedies and referral to the relevant authority.

Sellers must cooperate with safety investigations, recalls and valid refund claims. They can request a review of a marketplace decision by providing relevant evidence to support.

title: Seller Marketplace Agreement
body:
# Seller Marketplace Agreement

HastaBazaar is operated by Hasta Bazaar Private Limited (हस्त बजार प्राइभेट लिमिटेड), incorporated in Nepal under the Companies Act, 2063 and registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal under registration number 406171/83/84. Registered office: Birgunj Metropolitan City, Ward 11, Parsa, Madhesh Province, Nepal.

References to “HastaBazaar”, “we”, “us” and “our” in this policy mean Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, unless the context states otherwise. Current company and PAN details are available on our [Legal & Policies page](/legal#company-details).

This agreement is between Hasta Bazaar Private Limited, operating as HastaBazaar, and the seller accepting it. It governs selling through HastaBazaar. A seller must accept the agreement and complete the required verification before the seller account is activated. Submitting an application does not guarantee approval.

## Seller eligibility and information

You must be legally authorised to trade and to represent the business applying for the account. Provide accurate identity, business, tax, contact and settlement information, together with any licence required for your products. Keep these details current.

HastaBazaar may request relevant evidence to verify an application or investigate a compliance issue. Seller verification documents are handled under the Privacy Policy.

## Listings and product responsibilities

You are responsible for the legality, authenticity, quality and safety of your products. Keep prices, stock, preparation times and descriptions accurate. Disclose relevant materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, warnings, expiry dates and warranty terms before purchase.

Do not describe an item as handmade, locally made or certified without supporting evidence. You must own or have permission to use your listing photographs, text, brand names and designs.

## Commission and charges

HastaBazaar charges a 9% commission on completed, paid product sales. There is no joining fee.

The commission base is the product selling value after seller-funded discounts, excluding separately stated product taxes and delivery charges. A discount funded entirely by HastaBazaar does not reduce the seller's agreed product value.

Commission = commission base x 9%.

For example, when the commission base is NPR 1,000, the commission is NPR 90. The remaining product proceeds are NPR 910 before any applicable, separately disclosed tax or agreed adjustment. Delivery charges are not included in this calculation.

Tax legally chargeable on HastaBazaar's commission is itemised separately. Additional optional services require the seller's prior agreement to their charges. No undisclosed fee is deducted.

Commission is not charged on cancelled or unfulfilled sales. When an item payment is refunded, the corresponding commission is reversed; partial refunds receive a proportional reversal.

## Order fulfilment

Fulfil accepted orders within the preparation and dispatch periods agreed with the customer. Package products safely and include the required invoice, receipt, labels and instructions.

Do not substitute products, alter an accepted price, misstate dispatch or delivery, or move a marketplace order off-platform to avoid commission. Notify HastaBazaar promptly when an order cannot be fulfilled or a delay arises.

## Returns, refunds and customer remedies

You must comply with HastaBazaar's Return, Exchange, Cancellation & Refund Policy and applicable consumer rights. Do not require an unboxing video as the only acceptable evidence, insist on store credit in place of a monetary refund, or reject a claim solely because a product is custom-made.

You are responsible for refunds and reasonable direct costs attributable to your defective products, inaccurate listings, fulfilment errors or other breaches. Responsibility for loss or damage must follow the evidence and applicable law; a seller is not automatically liable for an error caused by HastaBazaar or an unrelated delivery provider.

Cooperate with customer remedies without waiting for a separate dispute about responsibility to be resolved.

## Settlements and adjustments

The payout method, settlement schedule and verified receiving account must be agreed in writing before seller activation. Settlement statements must identify the orders covered, sales proceeds, 9% commission, relevant taxes, refunds and any other authorised adjustment.

Amounts genuinely affected by a refund, payment reversal, fraud investigation or legal restriction can be held while the issue is resolved. We will explain the reason and amount, review the hold and release funds when the basis ends. Unrelated, undisputed funds remain payable on the agreed schedule.

Deductions must be supported by an order record, an agreed charge or another lawful basis. Sellers may challenge an adjustment through support@hastabazaar.com and receive an explanation of the outcome.

## Customer information and content

Use customer information only to fulfil the relevant order, provide after-sales support and meet legal duties. Do not sell it, add customers to marketing lists without valid consent or disclose it to unrelated parties.

You retain ownership of your listing content. You grant HastaBazaar a non-exclusive licence to display, format and reproduce that content to operate and promote your listings and the marketplace. Verification documents and private customer information are excluded from this licence.

## Restrictions, closure and disputes

HastaBazaar may pause listings or restrict an account for unlawful products, misleading information, serious service failures, fraud or breaches of this agreement. We will explain the reason and provide a review route unless doing so is legally prohibited or would compromise an investigation.

You may request account closure after resolving open orders and obligations. Closure or suspension does not forfeit undisputed earnings or cancel customer refunds, lawful recordkeeping duties or existing claims.

Nepalese law governs this agreement. Either party can seek review through the competent authority or court. Changes to commission or other material commercial terms require advance notice and apply only to future orders under the updated accepted terms, not to existing orders.

For seller support and disputes, contact support@hastabazaar.com.
